Title: Public preview: Azure Site Recovery integration with SQL Server AlwaysOn

Body.Content: Azure Site Recovery now provides native support for SQL Server AlwaysOn. SQL Server Availability Groups can be added to a recovery plan with virtual machines. All the capabilities of your recovery plan—including sequencing, scripting, and manual actions—can be leveraged to orchestrate the failover of a multitier applications by using a SQL Server database that is configured with AlwaysOn replication. Site Recovery is now available through the Microsoft Operations Management Suite, across on-premises or cloud environments. For more information, please visit the Azure Site Recovery page.
Body.Markdown:
Azure Site Recovery now provides native support for SQL Server AlwaysOn. SQL Server Availability Groups can be added to a recovery plan with virtual machines. All the capabilities of your recovery plan—including sequencing, scripting, and manual actions—can be leveraged to orchestrate the failover of a multitier applications by using a SQL Server database that is configured with AlwaysOn replication.

Site Recovery is now available through the Microsoft Operations Management Suite , across on-premises or cloud environments.

For more information, please visit the Azure Site Recovery page.
